name: Halvath Cormarrin

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

sourceBooks: Monster Vault: Threats to the Nentir Vale

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description:
The heaviest type of armor, made up of shaped plates of metal or similarly resilient material, plate provides the most armor protection. The cost for its superior fortification is mobility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Plate armor grants +9 AC at levels 6-10, +10 AC at levels 11-15, +11 AC at levels 16-20, +12 AC at levels 21-25, and +14 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Heavy Shield
items.description: While you’re using a heavy shield, you can’t use your shield hand for any other task, since you must use that hand to handle the shield.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Until the Last Breath
traits.details: Whenever an ally in the aura drops to 0 hit points, that ally can immediately make a melee basic attack as a free action.

traits.name: Grim Solidarity
traits.details: If Cormarrin starts his turn adjacent to a creature that has grim solidarity, he can make a saving throw against one effect that a save can end.

auras.name: Until the Last Breath
auras.details: Whenever an ally in the aura drops to 0 hit points, that ally can immediately make a melee basic attack as a free action.

effect.description: Cormarrin uses ancient rune flail twice.

hit.description: thunder damage, and Cormarrin pushes the target 1 square and knocks it prone.

miss.description: Half damage, and Cormarrin pushes the target 1 square.

powers.name: Cry of Glory
powers.trigger: An ally within 10 squares of Cormarrin hits with an attack that isn’t a critical hit.

effect.description: Close burst 10 (triggering ally in the burst). The ally instead scores a critical hit.
